title: At 24% APR, Debt Doubles Every 3 Years
hook_text: AT 24% APR DEBT DOUBLES EVERY 3 YEARS

beats.say: At 24% APR, debt doubles every 3 years. That's the Rule of 72 working against you.
beats.visual: A close-up of a calendar flipping pages in a dimly lit room, cinematic shadows, slow motion.

beats.say: You're bleeding cash in interest. Let's fix that right now.
beats.visual: A sharp kitchen knife resting on a wooden cutting board, warm overhead lighting, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: Step one. Open your banking app and list every debt balance and interest rate.
beats.visual: A sleek modern laptop closed on a dark oak desk, soft morning window light from the side.

beats.say: Don't guess. Write down the exact numbers. You can't fight an enemy you don't see.
beats.visual: An empty black leather notebook lying open under a single desk lamp, macro shot.

beats.say: Step two. Pick your weapon. The debt avalanche targets your highest interest rate first.
beats.visual: A chess piece, a rook, standing on a dark wooden board, cinematic rim light.

beats.say: Mathematically, it's the fastest way out. You'll pay less total interest overall.
beats.visual: A fountain pen resting on blank heavy-grain paper, moody studio lighting.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions. Sometimes math isn't what keeps you going.
beats.visual: A vintage metal hourglass with dark sand falling slowly, macro focus on the neck.

beats.say: Step three. If you need quick wins to stay motivated, choose the debt snowball instead.
beats.visual: A small pile of smooth river stones stacked neatly on a slate tile, natural light.

beats.say: Knock out your smallest balance first, regardless of the rate.
beats.visual: A single heavy iron key resting on a rustic wooden table, overhead shot.

beats.say: Psychology beats math when quitting is your biggest risk.
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single bright doorway at the far end, cinematic perspective.

beats.say: Pick one strategy today. Lock it in, automate the payments, and never look back.
beats.visual: A heavy metal vault door closing shut, dramatic low-angle lighting, sparks flying.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A dark silhouette of a person walking away down a long corridor, minimalist framing.

caption: Math or momentum? Pick your debt strategy today and stop the bleed. #debtfree #personalfinance #moneytips #financialfreedom #smartmoney
description: Compare the debt avalanche and debt snowball methods. Learn how to pick the right strategy based on math or psychology to eliminate your debt faster.
first_comment: Are you Team Avalanche (math) or Team Snowball (momentum)? Drop your pick below.

facts.claim: At 24% APR debt doubles every 3 years by the Rule of 72
facts.basis: Rule of 72: at 8% money doubles every 9 years; at 24% debt doubles every 3 years
